ERROR:Int

req ERROR < 0

fun CHECK(b:Bool) : Int
{
  if b then
    42
  else
    ERROR
}

class A {
  x:Int
  y:Int
  z:Int * Bool

  req z = Tuple(1,true)

  req z # 1 = 1 && z # 2

  fun f : Int * Bool
  {
    Tuple(1,true)
  }

  req x > 20

  req exists i : Int . i > 0 && x + i = y

  req f() # 2
  RESULT:Int = CHECK(x > 20 && y > x)
}

class B {
  sat:Bool
  z:Int
  a:A

  req a.x <= 22

  req sat

  req !sat => (z = a.x)

  fun g(l:Int) : Int
  {
    l + 1
  }

  fun f(k:Int) : Int
  {
    g(k) + 1
  }

  req f(z) <= 22

  req a.x != a.y
  RESULT:Int = CHECK(sat && a.x <= 22 && z <= 20 && a.x != a.y)
}
